title: Hybrid hire activation & credential reconciliation lab
content:
Purpose:
This working doc captures a compact, operational playbook for activating hybrid (remote + office) engineering hires with two concurrent goals: (1) reduce time-to-productivity in the first 14 days, and (2) ensure credential/access reconciliation and rotation hygiene across cloud, internal services, and dedicated/private deployments.

Scope and audience:
- Scope: IC and senior IC engineering hires, plus lateral platform/infra hires that need hardware access (Dedicated/Private). Excludes contractor short-term temps (<30 days) — separate checklist.
- Audience: people-ops, hiring manager, onboarding buddy, platform infra owner, security engineering.

Key constraints we observed in prior runs:
- Over-granting of broad roles in first week to unblock work; leads to stale credentials.
- Unclear ownership of hardware access requests for Dedicated customers — slow approvals.
- New hires miss hidden dependencies (service accounts, vault paths, KMS keys) and waste time discovering them.

High-level activation flow (practical):
1) Offer accepted -> Preboard packet (48h): prefilled access map, hardware preference, preferred laptop config, key rotation opt-in.
2) Day -3 -> Security gating: invite to security onboarding session (30 min), ask for MFA setup screenshots.
3) Day 0 -> Core access live (email, Slack, SSO), laptop issued, SRE/infra 1:1 scheduled.
4) Day 1-3 -> Access reconciliation lab: manager, buddy, and infra owner run the reconciliation script (see checklist).
5) Day 4-14 -> Gradual escalation of privileges via timeboxed grants; automated removal of temporary grants on day 14 unless manager requests extension.

Preboarding packet (template items to auto-send):
- Welcome note + org chart + buddy intro + scheduled 1:1s.
- Prefilled 'access map' asking them to confirm what they will need (examples: dedicated-gpu-pool, private-vpc, staging-admin).
- Self-certify form for prior experience with privileged infra (if yes, require 1:1 with security).

Day 0 checklist (owner in parens):
- Confirm SSO and MFA are active (people-ops).
- Create base Slack channels and add to team channels (manager).
- Ensure laptop imaging complete and encryption enabled (IT).
- Invite to onboarding calendar blocks (people-ops).
- Create shadow telemetry links: repo access, dashboards, runbooks (buddy).

Access reconciliation lab (Day 1–3) — scripted walkthrough:
Purpose: align expected access with granted access and proactively rotate temporary credentials.
Participants: new hire (candidate), manager, infra owner (or SRE rep), buddy.
Steps (15–45 min):
- Confirm list of services/hardware from preboarding access map.
- Manager reads aloud initial privileges granted and why (explicit approval).
- Infra owner runs 'access-diff' script across common targets (GitHub org teams, AWS IAM, GCP IAM, Vault paths, internal service tokens).
- For each unexpected grant: either revoke + re-request with a ticket, or document explicit approval (ticket link).
- Create timeboxed temporary roles for any elevated access needed for ramp tasks (duration 14d).
- Schedule key rotation for any service account shared with the candidate: rotate now or schedule within 48h.

Timeboxing and automation rules (policy recommendation):
- Default elevated access expiry: 14 days. Extension requires manager JIRA note and security review for >30 days.
- For hardware access (Dedicated pools): owner must confirm a provisioning ticket within 24h of initial request.
- All temporary tokens created during onboarding must be created with an audit tag 'onboard:<hire-id>'.

Interview rubric tie-ins (for role-readiness signals):
Use interview signals to map access needs and speed expectations. Add a short blur of the candidate's answers to the hiring packet to guide early access decisions. Example fields to save in the hire packet: previous infra ownership (Y/N), experience with HSM/KMS (level 0-2), comfortable with credential rotation (Y/N).

Risk register (quick):
- Overprivilege -> remediation: access-diff and ticketed revocation within 72h.
- Missing hardware credentials -> remediation: temporary voucher and accelerated provisioning call.
- Credential sprawl (service accounts created without tagging) -> remediation: audit sweep on day 7 and auto-rotate flagged keys.

Quick templates (copy into People Ops automation):
- Temporary access grant template (manager approval + justification + expiry).
- Security 1:1 script for hires who self-certify privileged infra experience.
- Onboard audit tag format: onboard:<hire-initials>-<YYYYMMDD>.

Owner matrix (who does what):
- People Ops: preboarding packet, calendar blocks, SSO gating checks.
- Manager: approve baseline scopes, schedule role-specific 1:1s, sign extension tickets.
- Buddy: run shadow exercises, add to runbooks, initial code/PR walkthrough.
- Infra/SRE owner: run access-diff, provision hardware, tag temporary creds.
- Security: supervise rotation policy >30 day extensions, ad-hoc consult.

Metrics to track (first-pass):
- Time-to-first-commit (goal < 7 days).
- Number of revoked/unexpected grants found in access-diff (goal 0–2 per hire).
- % of temporary grants auto-expired at day 14 (goal > 95%).
- Time from hardware request to provisioning (goal < 48h).

Open questions and decisions needed from Security: (send to Security working group)
- Acceptable default expiry for elevated read-only roles? (14d vs 7d)
- Enforcement options: blocklist vs escalation tickets for hardware provisioning.

Next steps (immediate):
1) People Ops to add the onboarding audit tag to the provisioning automation by Aug 09.
2) Infra to provide a minimal 'access-diff' script runnable by a non-admin on Aug 12 (stub exists in linked GH repo).
3) Security to confirm extension process for elevated roles by Aug 15.

Notes to self / rough ideas (working doc section — keep):
- Consider a small 'onboard security quick lab' badge — short checklist that a hire can complete to earn broader privileges sooner.
- Revisit day 7 audit to include ephemeral tokens generated by CI jobs.
- Explore short-lived certs for Dedicated GPU nodes (avoid static SSH keys).

Appendix: Access-diff quick run (example commands) — put into Infra repo:
- git org-team-list && compare to GH team membership CSV;
- aws iam list-roles -> filter by tag onboard:<hire-id>;
- vault list secret/onboard/<hire-id> -> ensure tags present.

This doc is intentionally pragmatic and lightweight — goal is to fold into automation and the hire packet templates. Comments welcome; will iterate after first pilot of 5 hires.
